name: DOLOS: Your Best Future
detailed_description:
In this narrative management game, you will have to decide about the future of everyone according to the anticipations of an AI. Help create the efficient society of tomorrow or preserve the dreams and hopes of everybody. Your choices will affect the future of Gauetia.

After an unprecedented economic crisis and to deal with mass unemployment, the government of Gauetia appoints a young company, DOLOS Incorporated, to create a program capable of coordinating job and training seekers (students, unemployed) with the labour market in order to build a perfectly efficient society.

Capable of predicting the potential of each individual through large-scale data collection, DOLOS will become a central AI in the government's economic and social policy, but not without causing some damage...

WELCOME TO THE DOLOS SYSTEM

You are Theophile Agnos, an operator performing all kinds of micro-tasks on a daily basis. Although the tasks on the DOLOS app are underpaid, they have the advantage of being a video game.

Working on DOLOS is playing a management game and a card game, so that a group of applicants have a place for life in the perfectly efficient society dreamed up by DOLOS.

WORK PLAY FOR DOLOS

In the first game, select the best applicants applying for a training course. 

  • Add (or not) new data to the system to increase or decrease their success scores. 

  • The higher the scores, the more applicants you can select!

In the second game, all unselected applicants become playing cards.

  • Draw applicants and quickly place them in the courses they want or that DOLOS recommends. 

  • The more you follow DOLOS' recommendations, the more applicants you draw, the longer your turn lasts!

EMBRACE A SYSTEM…

  • Talk to your performance coach to optimize your productivity and earn even more EXP.

  • Complete progressive challenges, climb the operator hierarchy and earn unique perks! 

Will you become the best operator at DOLOS Incorporated?

... OR FIGHT IT FROM WITHIN!

  • Talk to your colleague and together investigate the hidden face of the software.

  • Discover the hidden stories of applicants condemned by DOLOS, bypass and exploit the rules of the game to help as many as possible slip through the cracks. 

But watch out for your EXP! If you run out, you're out!

MAKING CHOICES EVERYTIME...

You will have to contribute to the creation of a perfectly efficient society...or fight against the system to respect everyone's aspirations and preserve their freedom. Confront the destinies of the applicants, ask yourself what is the fairest for each one of them.

… AND FACE THEM LATER

Observe the consequences of your choices as the years go by.

  • Re-discover applicants from past years and see what they become.

  • Keep abreast of current events in Gauetia, seek out new information that can open up new narrative path, and learn more about the characters behind DOLOS.

  • Develop (or not) the relationship with your interlocutors to find out more about their role in this gripping story with many twists and variations.

All your choices - and those of the other operators - will determine Gauetia's future!

short_description: A sci-fi political thriller. Live the life of an operator of DOLOS, a social regulation system predicting everyone's future. Analyze applicants' profiles and decide about their lifetime career. Apply DOLOS' logic or find how to counter it ... but don't get fired!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 1030 or RX 550
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
